rule: Every symbol on the reels is real Stacks or Bitcoin material. Nothing is drawn or imitated by hand. A punk with no Forever Twins twin is shown desaturated with a NOT YET FOREVER stamp.

collection.name: Crash Punks
collection.creator: grace.btc
collection.note: 5,754 is the highest token id read from the contract. 614 ids returned no metadata from the Hiro metadata API and are not in any tier.

tiers.method: Rarity score = sum over a punk's traits of ln(collection size / trait frequency), computed across all 5,140 punks with metadata. Rarest 1% = Legendary, next 4% = Rare, the remaining 95% split into four equal tiers (Tier I rarest of the four).
tiers.tierStringFile: art/snow-crash-art.json (tierString: one character per token id, 0 = no metadata)
tiers.imageSource: IPFS Qmb84UcaMr1MUwNbYBnXWHM3kEaDcYrKuPWwyRLVTNKELC/<id>.png via https://images.gamma.io/cdn-cgi/image/width=160,height=160/https://stxnft.mypinata.cloud/ipfs/<cid>/<id>.png, re-encoded to webp q0.82

logos.name: This Is #1 mark
logos.file: tools/snow-crash/art/logos/this-is-number-one.svg (also embedded in the game as a data URI)
logos.source: thisisnumberone.com, the platform Crash Punks minted on. Fetched 2026-11-01. The exact asset URL was not recorded at fetch time: confirm it against the site before release.
logos.usedAs: The vault symbol on the reels and the club entrance and booth scenes. Used as supplied.
logos.permission: NEEDED: ask This Is #1 before the machine goes on the public floor.

logos.name: Crash Punks logo
logos.source: Not found. No official logo file could be located from the collection's Gamma page, the This Is #1 page or its socials from the tools available. Nothing was drawn or traced.
logos.usedAs: The scatter tile shows the name CRASH PUNKS set in type on a tile in the project's magenta; the cabinet topper (role crest) carries the same wording on the hologram.
logos.permission: NEEDED: the official logo file (and the project's OK) from the Crash Punks creator, grace.btc. Replace the typed tile and the topper texture when it arrives.

brandAssets.name: Xtrata mark
brandAssets.usedAs: Lower door of the cabinet, the souvenir ticket and the Forever tile. Used exactly as given.

brandAssets.name: ParallaX Casino wordmark
brandAssets.usedAs: Marquee foot. Used exactly as given, smaller than the machine name.

onChainRecords.what: A Crash Punk's Xtrata inscription id once twinned, otherwise its token number
onChainRecords.source: Read live from the Forever Twins registry (https://xtrata.xyz/forever-twins/data/registry.v2.json) and the collection's helper contract. No helper exists for Crash Punks yet, so every tile shows the token number.

live.failedRead: A failed or empty read is shown as unknown, never as no twins.
